function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate validated image artifacts through an enabled Image Generator provider. Specify provider to override the configured default.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

provider.description: Optional provider ID. If omitted, the configured default provider is used.

model.description: Optional provider model identifier. Supported values depend on the selected provider.

size.description: Optional image size in WIDTHxHEIGHT notation, such as 1024x1024. Supported values depend on the selected provider.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional aspect ratio represented as WIDTHxHEIGHT when size is omitted.

count.description: Number of images to generate. Subject to the configured per-request limit.

output_format.description: Requested output format when supported by the selected provider.

negative_prompt.description: Optional content to exclude when supported by the selected provider.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed when supported by the selected provider.
